name: openbb_commodity_search
description:
Meant to search commodity symbols through OpenBB (obb.commodity.search).
Returns: {tool, data_points, data}; OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.commodity.search, so data holds a single row whose text says "not available".
Inputs (* required): query* (default gold); provider (default yfinance).
Use fmp_commodity_list for a list of commodity symbols and openbb_derivatives_futures_historical for prices.
Example: {"query": "gold"}
